eplus.label: Built by EPLUS
eplus.blurb: Connectors the EPLUS team built for our own projects, files and training. They run on EPLUS servers and sign in with your Microsoft account.

anthropic.label: Built into Claude
anthropic.blurb: Made by Anthropic and part of the Claude desktop app: the browser, pages, skills, schedules and your Microsoft 365 account.

partner.label: Partner connectors
partner.blurb: Made by the software vendors themselves and approved for EPLUS. Each one signs in to your account with that service.

connectors.name: EPU Video Library
connectors.what: Every EPLUS University training video. Plays in the chat with a transcript that follows along, and you can search by what is said.
try: Play the part where they explain ...

tools.list_videos: List the videos in a folder, or the ones matching a word
tools.play_video: Play a video in the chat, with its transcript beside it
tools.search_videos: Search titles, folders and what is said in the videos

connectors.name: Punch Knowledge Hub
connectors.what: Four years of EPLUS punch walks: precedent, recurring deficiencies and the photos behind them.
try: How have we written up missing seismic bracing before?
What deficiencies keep coming back on data hall jobs?

tools.export_punch_report: Export punch items as a report
tools.get_punch_item: Open one punch item with its photos
tools.grep_punch: Exact-word search across every punch walk
tools.list_punch: List punch items, filtered by project, trade or status
tools.punch_stats: Counts and the deficiencies that keep coming back
tools.query_hermes_punch: Ask a question across four years of punch walks

connectors.name: RFI Knowledge Hub
connectors.what: Specifications and past RFI responses, so drafts cite the spec section. Nothing is saved without your sign-off.
try: Draft a response to this RFI with the spec section
Have we answered an RFI like this before?

tools.commit_approved_rfi: Save an approved RFI response to the knowledge base (after your OK)
tools.grep_corpus: Exact-word search across specs and past RFIs
tools.list_sources: List the documents in the knowledge base
tools.query_hermes_rfi: Ask a question across specs and past RFIs
tools.show_rfi_graph: Open an interactive map of the RFIs, submittals and specs on a topic

connectors.name: PlanGrid
connectors.what: Your PlanGrid projects, tasks, sheets and photos, which /punch-report turns into a draft report.
try: List the open tasks on ... in PlanGrid

tools.get_task_clips: A clip of the drawing around a task's pin
tools.pull_tasks: Pull a project's tasks for a report

connectors.name: Error Reporting
connectors.what: Sends problems and requests to the EPLUS team, including asking for a blocked website to be allowed.

tools.check_egress_host: Check whether a website is allowed from Claude's workspace
tools.get_report_status: Check on a report you filed
tools.list_egress_requests: List the requests to allow websites
tools.report_issue: Send a problem report to the EPLUS team
tools.request_egress_allow: Ask the EPLUS team to allow a website

connectors.name: Microsoft 365
connectors.what: Your Outlook mail and calendar, Teams chats and channels, SharePoint and OneDrive, signed in as you.

tools.find_meeting_availability: Find when a group of people is free
tools.get_granted_scopes: See what Claude has been allowed to read
tools.outlook_find_available_time: Find open time on your calendar
tools.read_resource: Open an email, file or message in full

connectors.note: Managed by EPLUS. Anthropic built this connector, but EPLUS decides which of its tools are turned on and what Claude is allowed to see in your Microsoft 365 account. If something you need isn't available, ask Victor.

connectors.name: Claude Browser
connectors.what: A browser inside the app. Claude opens sites, reads them, clicks through them and fills in forms while you watch, and you can take over any time.

tools.browser_batch: Run several browser steps in one go
tools.computer: Click, type, scroll and take screenshots
tools.find: Find something on the page by its text
tools.navigate: Go to an address, or back and forward
tools.preview_start: Open a site in a new tab
tools.read_page: Read the page's layout and buttons
tools.resize_window: Try a page at phone or tablet size
tools.tabs_select: Bring a tab to the front

connectors.name: Cowork
connectors.what: The desktop app itself: pages that open beside the chat, your folders, files Claude hands you and skills it saves.
try: Make me a page that tracks ...

tools.allow_cowork_file_delete: Ask your OK before deleting files in a folder
tools.create_artifact: Publish a new page beside the chat
tools.present_files: Hand you files Claude made, ready to open
tools.read_widget_context: Read what's in an interactive widget
tools.request_cowork_directory: Ask to open one of your folders
tools.save_skill: Save a skill to your / menu
tools.screenshot_artifact: Take a picture of a page to check it
tools.screenshot_file_preview: Take a picture of a file preview
tools.update_artifact: Replace a page with a new version

connectors.name: Workspace
connectors.what: Claude's private Linux workspace, where it runs Python, converts files and builds documents.

tools.bash: Run commands and scripts in Claude's workspace
tools.web_fetch: Fetch a web page or file

connectors.name: Scheduled Tasks
connectors.what: Jobs Claude runs on its own, once at a set time or every day or week.
try: What tasks do I have scheduled?

tools.create_scheduled_task: Set up a task that runs on a schedule
tools.update_scheduled_task: Change a task's timing or instructions

connectors.name: Skills
connectors.what: Finds skills you have and suggests ones worth adding.

connectors.name: Plugins
connectors.what: Finds plugins and connectors, including the EPLUS catalog, and offers to install them.

tools.suggest_plugin_install: Show an install card for a plugin

connectors.name: Session Info
connectors.what: Looks back at your earlier chats.
try: What did we work on yesterday?

connectors.name: Asana
connectors.what: Your Asana tasks, projects, portfolios and tables: read them, create them and keep them up to date.
try: What's due for me this week in Asana?

tools.create_project_from_template: Start a project from a template
tools.create_project_status_update: Post a status update on a project
tools.create_task_from_template: Create a task from a template
tools.get_agent: Look up an Asana AI agent
tools.get_items_for_portfolio: List the projects in a portfolio
tools.get_tasks: List the tasks in a project or section
tools.get_users: List the people in the workspace
tools.search_objects: Find projects, tasks or people by name
tools.update_tasks: Change tasks: assignee, due date, status and more

connectors.name: Firecrawl
connectors.what: Web search and scraping at scale: whole sites, research papers, US codes and regulations, and pages to watch for changes.
try: Research ... and give me the sources
Find the code section that covers ...

tools.firecrawl_agent: Hand a research job to Firecrawl's web agent
tools.firecrawl_developer_search: Search code, repositories and developer docs
tools.firecrawl_gov_search: Search US laws, codes and regulations
tools.firecrawl_interact: Click and type on a page Firecrawl has open
tools.firecrawl_map: List every page on a site
tools.firecrawl_monitor_check: One check from a page monitor
tools.firecrawl_parse: Turn a PDF or document into text
tools.firecrawl_scrape: Pull the content of one web page

connectors.name: Plaud AI
connectors.what: Recordings from your Plaud note-taker: transcripts and AI meeting notes.
try: What did we decide in Tuesday's site meeting?

tools.get_note: The AI notes for a recording
